svg.text: For the Open Innovation theme, Day Weave turns your day into cloth: twenty-four threads, one per hour, are woven in
colour as you live it, indigo for sleep, green for movement and gold for work, with the current hour glowing on the
loom. A swipe shows your whole week as a woven swatch, so habits become a pattern you can see rather than a chart.
Always-on keeps the woven strip in grey under the time.

g.text: Each thread is one hour of today

svg.text: 368 × 448 rectangular OLED · text ≥ 21 px · icons ≥ 25 px · always-on on true black · all names fictional, no logos · Designed by Amritha S
